test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which track and field event is the hop used?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Triple jump.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Triple Jump**
 
• Other Names:** hop, step, and jump**
 
• **In this, **an athlete makes a** horizontal jump** for** distance incorporating three distinct, continuous movements.**
 
• **Movements are:**
 
 
• **​hop:** an athlete takes off and lands on the same foot,
 
• **step:** landing on the other foot,
 
• **jump**: landing in any manner, usually with both feet together. (If a jumper touches the ground with the wrong leg, the jump is disallowed).
 
 
 
• **Modern Olympics event** since the **Games' inception in 1896.**
 
• Current male world record holder: **Jonathan Edwards of the United Kingdom** (a jump of 18.29 m)
 
• Current female world record holder:** Yulimar Rojas of Venezuela **(a jump of 15.74 m).

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Javelin Throw**

 
 
• Track and field event where the** javelin, a spear about 2.5 m in length, is thrown.**
 
• The javelin thrower gains **momentum by running within a predetermined area.**
 
• An event of both the **men's decathlon and the women's heptathlon.**
 
• The inventor of the modern javelin throwing technique is **Eric Lemming from Sweden.**
 
 
 
• **High Jump**
 
 
• **Track and field event in which competitors must jump unaided over a horizontal bar placed at measured heights without dislodging it**.
 
• Three types of high jump styles: **the Fosbury flop, western roll or side roll, and straddle style.**
 
 
 
• **Broad Jump**
 
 
• The **standing long jump: standing broad jump**, an **athletics event**.
 
• It was an** Olympic event until 1912**.
 
• **One of three standing variants of track and field jumping events includes** the** standing high jump **and** standing triple jump.**
